asset: Outfit variants of the five Meshy people (base color only): new clothes, skin and hair colors on the same mesh and UVs, so the pbr walkers do not repeat.
tool: Meshy retexture API (meshy-7, input_task_id = the refine task of each person in ../provenance.json, enable_original_uv true, 2K base color, no PBR maps); Blender 5.x headless: scripts/blender/people_variants.py takes the base color of each retextured GLB and writes a 512 px JPEG 85 (Standard view transform).
pipeline: Raw GLBs in git-ignored .meshy-raw/people-variants/ (<kind>_v<n>.glb); blender -b -P scripts/blender/people_variants.py -- .meshy-raw/people-variants assets/people/variants 512
license: Generated with the project owner's Meshy account; usage is governed by Meshy's terms of service for that account.
style: Same as the people: positive everyday Atlantans, no branding. Each variant was checked on the game mesh (a Blender render of all 15); one was rejected.

credits.approved_by: the project owner, in the session of 2026-11-07 (150 credits)
